EngLawName: Sanitation Standards for Butane to be Used in Food
name: 食品用丁烷衛生標準

articles.content: The Standards are prescribed in accordance with the provisions of Article 17 of the Act Governing Food Sanitation.

Butane as referred to these standards including both n-butane (CAS Reg. No. 106-97-8) and isobutane (CAS Reg. No. 75-28-5). The formula of the chemical is indicated as C4H10, and its molecular weight is 58.12.

N-butane to be used in food shall comply with the requirements according to the following standards:
┌──────────┬───────────────────┐
│      Item          │              Standards               │
├──────────┼───────────────────┤
│Purity              │Not less than 96% (v/v)               │
├──────────┼───────────────────┤
│Characteristics     │Colorless, and flammable gasthe flavor│
│                    │of natural gas                        │
├──────────┼───────────────────┤
│Boiling temperature │-0.5℃                                │
├──────────┼───────────────────┤
│Solubility          │One volume of water dissolves 0.15    │
│                    │volume; 1 volume of alcohol dissolves │
│                    │18 volumes; 1 volume of ether         │
│                    │dissolves 25 volumes, at 17 ℃ and 770│
│                    │mmHg.                                 │
├──────────┼───────────────────┤
│Infrared absorption │The spectrum of a sample exhibits     │
│spectrum            │absorptions,at approximately          │
│                    │ 3.4 μ m(vs), 6.8 μ                 │
│                    │m(s), 7.2μm(m) and 10.4μm (m).      │
├──────────┼───────────────────┤
│Moisture content    │Not exceed 0.005 %                    │
├──────────┼───────────────────┤
│High-boiling residue│Not exceed 5 mg/kg                    │
├──────────┼───────────────────┤
│Acidity of          │Add 10 mL of water to the sample, mix │
│high-boiling residue│by swirling for about 30 s, add 2     │
│                    │drops of methyl orange TS, insert the │
│                    │stopper in the tube, and shake the    │
│                    │tube vigorously. No pink or red color │
│                    │appears in the aqueous layer.         │
├──────────┼───────────────────┤
│Sulfur compounds    │The gas is free from the              │
│analysis            │characteristic odor of sulfur         │
│                    │compounds.                            │
└──────────┴───────────────────┘

│                    │3.4 μ m(vs), 6.8 μ m(s), 7.2μm(m   │
│                    │ and 10.9μm (m).                     │
├──────────┼───────────────────┤
│Moisture content    │Not exceed 0.005 %                    │

│High-boiling residue│Not exceed 5 mg/kg                    │

│Acidity of          │Add 10 mL of water to the sample, mix │

│                    │drops of methyl orange TS, insert the │
│                    │stopper in the tube, and shake the    │
│                    │tube vigorously. No pink or red color │
│                    │appears in the aqueous layer.         │
├──────────┼───────────────────┤
│Sulfur compounds    │The gas is free from the              │

The Standards shall be implemented on the date of promulgation.
